intro.h2: A Manheim crew that listens before it builds
paragraphs: ALL Renovation & Design has handled kitchen remodeling in Lancaster, PA and across southcentral Pennsylvania since 2006. The office is on Penryn Road in Manheim, and the same team takes on baths, basements, additions and outdoor kitchens. Founder Amos Lapp built the company on the careful detail work he learned growing up in an Amish family.

The method is plain. Cabinets, tile and fixtures are all chosen before demolition, so the crew never stalls waiting on a decision. You then sign a written Project Plan that lists your start date, expected length and final cost. Past clients say they felt heard, and one Lititz couple just finished their fourth project with the firm.

services.h2: Kitchen Remodeling in Lancaster, PA, Plus Baths, Basements and Additions

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Many older homes here have cramped, dated kitchens. The team moves or removes walls, builds custom cabinetry, adds islands, sinks and new counters, and replaces flooring and appliances. Recent kitchens went into homes in Hershey, Hummelstown, Lititz, Manheim and Lancaster.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel in Hershey, PA with a new island, added countertop space and new lighting

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Tile floors, custom tile showers, new cabinetry and his-and-her sinks are all routine work. The crew can swap an old tub for a walk-in shower or turn a closet or attic corner into a new bath. Recent baths were finished in Lititz, Lebanon, Manheim and Red Lion.

image.alt: Spa-style bathroom remodel in Lebanon, PA with custom cabinets and a walk-in shower

items.name: Basement Finishing
items.blurb: An unfinished lower level can become an in-law suite, a home office or a place to host friends. One basement in Lititz was built for entertaining, with a U-shaped bar, farm sink, ice machine and custom quartz and granite counters.

image.alt: Finished basement den remodel in Lititz, PA designed for entertaining

items.name: Home Additions
items.blurb: When the house is simply too small, the team designs bedroom suites, bathroom additions, kitchen extensions, sunrooms, in-law suites and second stories. Each addition is planned to blend with the rooms you already have, whether the job is a small bump-out or a large expansion.

image.alt: Four-seasons dining room addition on a home in Lancaster, PA

items.name: Outdoor Kitchens and Patios
items.blurb: Stamped concrete patios, pergolas, stone retaining walls and outdoor kitchens move family meals into the yard. One Lancaster project paired a hardscaped patio and outdoor kitchen with a four-seasons room. Planning starts with the same phone call as any indoor job.

image.alt: Stamped concrete patio and outdoor kitchen beside a four-seasons room addition in Lancaster, PA

why_choose_us.h2: Four reasons clients hire ALL again and again

items.title: Workmanship covered for up to 10 years
items.text: ALL guarantees its workmanship against defects for up to 10 years from the date the work is done. If a problem shows up in work they completed, the team comes back to fix it.

about.h2: Meet Amos Lapp, founder of ALL Renovation & Design
about.text: Amos Lapp founded ALL Renovation & Design LLC in 2006 with one goal: to serve clients through a high level of craftsmanship in every area of construction and remodeling. He comes from an Amish background and still enjoys the hard work and small details that bring a project to life. Longtime client George S. remembers when Amos was a one-man team. Today the company has its own designers, cabinetmakers, carpenters and finishers, and clients often name them in reviews, from designer Ronda to carpenter Mike P. The firm marked its 20th year with a press release in 2026.

image.alt: Amos Lapp, founder of ALL Renovation & Design in Manheim, PA

process.h2: How a project moves from phone call to final walkthrough

steps.title: Phone conversation
steps.text: A 10 to 20 minute call covers your plans, goals and budget. If the fit looks right on both sides, the team books a visit to your home.

steps.title: In-home consultation
steps.text: Staff walk the house, take measurements and check for structural limits. If scope, budget and timeline line up, you get a preliminary concept with a realistic budget.

steps.title: Design agreement and Project Plan
steps.text: A signed design agreement and a small non-refundable payment start design and permits. The Project Plan then lists every selection, the start date, duration and final cost.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: The crew seals off the work area and keeps the rest of your home livable. Expect updates at least twice a day on progress and the next day's work.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: You walk the finished space together with the team. If anything is not right, staff are called in to fix it on the spot.

service_area.h2: Where the ALL team works in southcentral Pennsylvania
service_area.text: ALL Renovation & Design is based in Manheim and takes projects across the Lancaster, Lebanon, Harrisburg, Reading and York areas. Recent jobs include kitchens in Hershey and Hummelstown, baths in Lebanon and Red Lion, and basements in Lititz. The towns below are the ones the firm lists on its own site. If yours is not here, ask, because the list ends with "and more."

faq.h2: Common questions before a Lancaster County remodel

items.a: The first three steps cost nothing: a phone conversation, an in-home consultation and a preliminary estimate or solution for your project. ALL prefers this to a quick free quote because it gives a more accurate cost, so the number does not jump later. Full design work starts with a signed design agreement and a small non-refundable payment.

items.q: What warranty comes with the work?
items.a: ALL guarantees its workmanship against defects for up to 10 years from the date the work is performed. If you run into a problem with work the team completed, they will come back and fix it. Ask during your consultation how the guarantee applies to your specific project.

items.q: How long will my remodel take?
items.a: Real remodels take weeks, not the hour you see on a TV show. The most common planning mistake ALL sees is expecting too short a timeline. Your written Project Plan states the start date and expected duration, and because every selection is made before construction, the crew is not held up waiting on choices.

items.q: When is the best time of year to start?
items.a: The best time is whenever the work disrupts your life the least. Winter suits interior jobs like kitchens and baths because they do not depend on weather. For an addition, spring or late summer into fall works well. The team has scheduled around teachers who wanted work done in summer.

items.q: Where do I pick out cabinets, tile and fixtures?
items.a: A designer walks you through selections in the ALL showroom, at a vendor's showroom or in your home. Reviewers often mention designer Ronda's help with lighting and finishes. Everything is chosen and written into the Project Plan before construction begins, along with colors, allowances and final costs.

final_cta.text: Call 717-665-0470, Monday to Friday from 7 am to 5 pm, or send the form and the team will set up a 10 to 20 minute call about your kitchen or bath.
